prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
(none yet)

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
(not available)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 84.4%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 67.3%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 85.8%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 73.5%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 27.3%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Interactive Pet Trait Customizer Stage: Redesign the pet adoption selection into an interactive stage layout where users select pet personality traits and appearance styles before finalizing adoption. (why: Adoption has the lowest step conversion rate in the onboarding funnel at 67.3% with a long median time of 89s, indicating users hesitate during selection.)
1: [choose_path, new_screen] Interactive Desktop Pet Teaser Screen: Insert a new introductory screen right after story that displays an animated preview of a desktop pet roaming and reacting to user clicks. (why: Choose path has a high mean duration (514s) and 76.2% conversion rate; setting clear visual expectations of desktop pet behaviors builds immediate motivation.)
2: [finish, new_flow] Guided Desktop Pet Control & Mode Sandbox Flow: Add an interactive mini-sandbox step at the end of onboarding where users practice hiding, summoning, and interacting with their pet. (why: 3 support emails reported post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control, hide, or talk to the pet, and finish step has a high mean duration (5815s).)
3: [sign_in, reorder] Sign-In Relocation Post Adoption Certificate: Move the sign-in step to occur right after the adoption certificate screen when the pet has been created and named. (why: 8 support emails cited pets missing or reset after signing in again; prompting sign-in immediately after pet naming strongly ties account creation to pet preservation.)
4: [choose_path, layout] Split Layout Path Selection Comparison: Change the path selection screen layout to a side-by-side split format contrasting quick preset adoption against custom photo pet generation. (why: Choose path conversion is 76.2% with a long mean duration of 514s; a split visual layout speeds up decision-making between paths.)
5: [finish, hint] Desktop Taskbar & Tray Visibility Callout: Add a visual callout hint on home intro explaining where the pet lives in the system tray and how to summon it back. (why: 3 support emails reported pet not showing on desktop or app not opening, and 3 reported confusion over controlling/hiding pets.)
6: [sign_in, copy] Account Sync & Cloud Rescue Messaging: Update sign-in screen copy to explicitly explain how signing in safeguards pet data and prevents accidental resets. (why: 8 support emails complained about missing or reset pets after signing in again, making cloud sync assurance vital during sign-in.)
7: [adoption, notification] Photo Upload Preview & Quality Checker: Add a photo preview component with dynamic photo quality tips on the photo upload screen during custom pet adoption. (why: 3 support emails noted custom pet creation failing or looking incorrect due to photo source issues during adoption.)
